title: Crazy Kitchen: Five-Tense Question Bank
audience: Secondary classroom; mixed proficiency; short contextual sentences.
studentDirections: Choose the form that best fits the context. The game practises present simple, present continuous, past simple, past continuous, and future simple. For typed questions, replace only the bold words and keep the same main verb. For rebuild questions, use every word once. Your teacher makes the final decision.
studentDirectionsZh: 根据语境作答。本游戏练习一般现在时、现在进行时、一般过去时、过去进行时和一般将来时。输入改错题只填写加粗部分的正确形式，保留原来的主要动词；重组句子题每个单词使用一次。最终由老师判定。

presentationRules.note: Reference answers and explanations are teacher-facing until an explicit reveal. Do not show tense labels or group student rounds under visible tense names. Rebuild tokens are the puzzle, not an additional hint.

answerMatching.typed: Normalize the submission and every accepted variant, then compare for exact equality to provide an optional host-only suggestion. Never automatically mark the answer.
normalizationSteps: Replace curly apostrophes (U+2018, U+2019, U+02BC) with a straight apostrophe.
Collapse internal whitespace to one space.
Remove spaces immediately before and after apostrophes.
Remove optional terminal sentence punctuation: periods, exclamation marks, and question marks.
answerMatching.multipleChoice: Compare the selected stable option id with correctOptionId for a host-only suggestion, even when options are shuffled. The teacher decides Accept/Reject.
doNot: Accept an entire sentence as a replacement.
Treat a different main verb as a correct tense repair.
answerMatching.fullSentenceResponse: Give a format reminder and allow another try without marking the grammar as incorrect.
answerMatching.alternateGrammarPolicy: The teacher can accept any defensible answer in context. Reference answers and alternates guide judgment; they are not an exhaustive grammar rule or an automatic grade.
answerMatching.sentenceRebuild: Require each supplied token id exactly once and compare the order with acceptedTokenOrders for a host-only suggestion. The teacher can accept other valid orders; case and punctuation do not decide the grade.

promptSegments.text: lunch at 7 a.m. She follows the same routine each day.

feedback.explanation: This is Maya’s regular habit, so use the present simple. With Maya (she), pack becomes packs.
feedback.explanationZh: “Every weekday”和“same routine”表示日常习惯，用一般现在时；Maya 是第三人称单数，所以用 packs。

promptSegments.text: on Sundays. This is its regular weekly schedule.

feedback.explanation: A regular weekly schedule takes the present simple. The negative for the singular subject our café is does not + open.
feedback.explanationZh: 固定的每周安排用一般现在时；our café 是单数，否定形式为 does not / doesn’t open。

promptSegments.text: Ella goes to school the same way every morning.

questions.canonicalAnswer: Ella walks to school every morning.
acceptedVariants: Ella walks to school every morning.
Every morning Ella walks to school.

feedback.explanation: Use Ella + walks for a regular habit. Every morning can go at the beginning or the end.
feedback.explanationZh: 日常习惯用一般现在时；Ella 后接 walks。“Every morning”可放在句首或句末。

promptSegments.text: Our library’s regular hours are on this sign. It ___ at 9 a.m. every weekday.

feedback.explanation: The sentence describes the library’s regular opening time, so the present simple opens fits best.
feedback.explanationZh: 图书馆的固定开放时间用一般现在时；it 后用 opens。

promptSegments.text: Maya is in the kitchen at this moment.

questions.canonicalAnswer: Maya is making lunch right now.
acceptedVariants: Maya is making lunch right now.
Right now Maya is making lunch.
Maya is right now making lunch.

feedback.explanation: An action happening right now uses is + making with Maya. Right now can go at the beginning or the end, and can also follow is.
feedback.explanationZh: 此刻正在发生的动作，用现在进行时 is making。“Right now”可放在句首、句末，也可放在 is 后。

promptSegments.text: Please be quiet. I ___ to the instructions right now.

feedback.explanation: Right now shows an action in progress. With I, use am + listening.
feedback.explanationZh: “Right now”表示正在进行的动作；I 后用 am listening。

promptSegments.text: The timer rang ten minutes ago. Oscar ___ the cake out of the oven immediately.

feedback.explanation: Oscar completed the action ten minutes ago, so use the past simple took.
feedback.explanationZh: 动作发生在十分钟前并已完成，用一般过去时 took。

promptSegments.text: At 7 p.m. yesterday, Mina was halfway through her report.

questions.canonicalAnswer: Mina was working at seven yesterday.
acceptedVariants: Mina was working at seven yesterday.
At seven yesterday Mina was working.
Yesterday Mina was working at seven.
Yesterday at seven Mina was working.
Mina was working yesterday at seven.

feedback.explanation: The work was in progress at a past moment, so use Mina + was working. The time phrases have more than one natural position.
feedback.explanationZh: 过去某一时刻正在进行的动作，用 Mina was working；时间短语可以有不同的自然位置。

promptSegments.text: When I entered the kitchen yesterday, Dad was halfway through chopping an onion. He ___ it as I walked in.

feedback.explanation: Dad was halfway through the action when I entered. An action in progress at a past time takes was chopping.
feedback.explanationZh: 我进厨房时，爸爸切洋葱的动作正在进行，用过去进行时 was chopping。

promptSegments.text: This is a prediction about tomorrow’s match.

questions.canonicalAnswer: Our team will win the match tomorrow.
acceptedVariants: Our team will win the match tomorrow.
Tomorrow our team will win the match.

feedback.explanation: A prediction about tomorrow uses will + win. Tomorrow can go at the beginning or the end.
feedback.explanationZh: 对未来的预测用 will win；“Tomorrow”可放在句首或句末。

promptSegments.text: That bag looks heavy. I ___ it for you.

feedback.explanation: The speaker offers help now. Will + carry expresses this immediate offer.
feedback.explanationZh: 说话者此刻主动提出帮忙，用 will carry。
